subject: Please verify stage & close for aging opps - EOY tidy
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.h@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.i@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.m@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.c@redwood.com>, Laura Chen <laura.chen@finex.com>
Cc: 
Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Request: EOY pipeline sanity check for aging opportunities

Hi team,

Attached is an SFDC export of opportunities with no stage change or updated close date in >60 days. As we close out the year I need each AE/account owner to do one of the following for the rows they own:

- Confirm the current stage and updated close date (if still valid)
- Move to "No Commit" (or Lost) with a short reason in the reason field
- If the opportunity is progressing, add the next activity + expected close week

Specific asks:
- Karthik / Marissa: please prioritize Finex Analytics (highlighted rows) — these are in the Dec forecast and we need clarity for finance.
- Rishi: FYI on forecast impact if several of these move to No Commit.
- Laura: if any internal timeline changes on your side, let us know the new target close week.

Deadline: Please update SFDC and reply-all with a one-line confirmation by EOD Monday 12/21. If we don't have an update by then I'll mark stale opps as "No Commit" in the forecast, which will affect our December numbers.

Attachment: SFDC_export_aging_opps_20261218.csv (CSV, 1.2MB)

Thanks — short and simple here, this is remedial cleanup not a blame exercise.

Regards,
Mina Haddad
Senior Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
mina.h@redwood.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.i@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.h@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.m@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.c@redwood.com>, Laura Chen <laura.chen@finex.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 10:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: EOY pipeline sanity check for aging opportunities

On Fri, Dec 18, 2026 at 9:15 AM Mina Haddad <mina.h@redwood.com> wrote:
> Attached is an SFDC export of opportunities with no stage change or updated close date in >60 days.

Got it. I'll take ownership of the highlighted Finex rows and run a quick outreach today to confirm status. Two quick clarifying Qs for Mina:
1) If an AE confirms a new expected close "month" (not an exact day), is that sufficient for forecasting?
2) For deals that are still active but uncommitted, should I set Probability to 25% and move to "Commit Review" or leave probability as-is and add notes?

I'll reply-all with updates as I get confirmations.

Thanks,
Karthik
Account Executive
Redwood Inference
karthik.i@redwood.com
From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@finex.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.h@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.i@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.m@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Dec 2026 08:43:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: EOY pipeline sanity check for aging opportunities

Thanks for the heads up, Mina.

We had one internal delay on procurement for the Finex Renewal (line item RDW-34219) that moved the expected internal approval out by ~3 weeks. I'll confirm the new target week by EOD today — likely mid-Jan. For forecast purposes, you can mark the two affected opps as "Active - extended" but please don't mark Lost. If you need a hard close date I can provide a tentative week.

Appreciate the outreach — Karthik, happy to jump on a quick call if that helps.

Best,
Laura Chen
Director of Platform Ops
Finex Analytics
laura.chen@finex.com
From: Mina Haddad <mina.h@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.i@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.m@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.c@redwood.com>, Laura Chen <laura.chen@finex.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Dec 2026 11:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: EOY pipeline sanity check for aging opportunities

Thanks everyone — quick notes and next steps:

- Karthik: confirming that a month/week granularity is acceptable for the forecast. Please set Probabilities based on your confidence level; if an AE wants the opp to remain in the forecast but is uncertain, reduce probability and add a one-line rationale.
- Laura: thanks for the note — marking the Finex items as "Active - extended" for now. If you confirm mid-Jan by EOD we'll leave them as Active; if not, we'll move to No Commit on 12/27 to keep the EOY numbers realistic.
- Rishi / Marissa: I'll run a quick report on 12/22 to see outstanding updates; anything unresolved then I'll reassign for follow-up.

Reminder: this is a hygiene pass to ensure finance isn't carrying stale commits into the close. Small updates in SFDC + a one-line reply here are enough.

I'll close the loop after the 12/22 sweep.

Regards,
Mina Haddad
Senior Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
mina.h@redwood.com
